notes: Tuition: the DAAD page gives 6,120 EUR per semester for non-EU applicants (period read as semester since the heading says 'Tuition fees per semester'), while EU applicants pay 5,700 EUR; the page also warns 'Tuition fees may vary'. Intakes: the DAAD page states 'This programme has no deadline listed'; no dated deadline for international applicants is given, so intake dates are omitted. Application channel: no page mentions uni-assist or a VPD, and no page states that a foreign-diploma applicant must apply via uni-assist; the Fresenius application-process page refers to uploads 'to the application portal', so de-university-direct is used, but the DAAD page says only 'Submit application via Please check this website.'. B2 language requirement: quotes come from the DAAD programme page (the only page with stated admission conditions); acceptedTests lists only TOEFL and IELTS, which are the tests named.

evidence.quote: your English language skills must be equivalent to Level B2 of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR)
English language skills B2 required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.: TOEFL iBT (before 2026): 70 Reading: 18 Listening: 17 Speaking: 20 Writing: 17 IELTS Academic: 6

note.fr: Un entretien d'admission de 15 minutes est prévu après vérification de votre dossier ; il n'est pas un test de connaissances.
note.en: A 15-minute admission interview is scheduled after your documents are checked; it is not a knowledge test.

evidence.quote: If you fulfil the admission requirements, your personal study advisor will invite you to an admission interview.
